test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

UNCLEAR : CNULRAE :: PRIVACY : IRPVYCA :: NUCLEAR : ?
solution:
The positional values of English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

UNCLEAR is written as CNULRAE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dba8aba1a570759d5c114b22995b1712efd0848d601a72e436e79afdeca9c5b.png] 

And,

PRIVACY is written as IRPVYCA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa97242ab66ebccb11dbd576aba59e788bc13cf1c0673736db599eeda4177bab.png] 

Similarly,

NUCLEAR is written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d089cb621c33270c8c7d4aba5f1a58a3551cd9c313bfcec7e3b7d0640eb701ca.png] 

Hence,** 'CUNLRAE'** is the correct answer.
